title: Orenucopia
description: Ores galore. Adds colorful ore outcrops to world generation
body:
Feel free to use this mod in your modpack!

![Ore outcrops display](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bfc700f6f5480a9f7136d77d42e879a831df11bc.png)

## Description

Orenucopia is a mod focused on expanding the caving experience by adding new 3d ore outcrops on world generation.  

These outcrops come in a normal size for all ores and a small for all except coal and diamond.  

Additionally, you can grow your own outcrops by combining a raw ore (or gem) with 2 amethyst shards, yielding a seed of that ore.

The seed can then be planted on any solid surface and grow up to a small size if it has one.

When placed on a corresponding ore block, the seed will grow up to full size.


## Upcoming

Nether quartz, nether gold ore and ancient debris outcrops.
If the mod is popular enough I will add other mod compatibilities like Create's zinc.
I also plan to bring this mod to 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 when I have the time to.


## Thank you

I make mods as a hobby, and I'm excited to polish and expand on them. Stay tuned as I have many mods planned, each better than the last!

Thank you for viewing my mods <3
